body.statement: Fix \(\delta\in[0,1]\). If \(\mathcal P_\delta(b,q,\omega)=\varnothing\), the audit returns fiber infeasibility and does not certify \(\text{ass:reference-risk-positivity}\). If \(\mathcal P_\delta(b,q,\omega)\neq\varnothing\), that restriction holds if and only if the linear program \(\min\{d_{21,\omega}^{\top}x:E_\omega x=d(b,q),\ F_\delta x\leq0,\ x\geq0\}\) has value at least \(\epsilon\). Equivalently, there are \(\eta\) and \(\kappa\geq0\) satisfying \(E_\omega^{\top}\eta-F_\delta^{\top}\kappa\leq d_{21,\omega}\) and \(d(b,q)^{\top}\eta\geq\epsilon\).
body.justification: This implementation audit separates incompatible observed margins from a genuinely nonempty fiber whose late vaccine reference risk is uniformly positive.
body.gap: This is an LP audit device for the optional denominator restriction, not a root identification contribution.
body.consumer: Software can stop on an infeasible fiber and issue a primal value and dual certificate only after compatibility has been established.
